from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/services/catalogue-commission-terms')
terms = root / 'terms-en-fr.md'
crosswalk = root / 'acceptance-crosswalk.json'
packet = Path('products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/operator-reply-packet.json')
expected = '449856ff717c44da65c951b67732f916971c35fee3d4c98642d1cd3b2002ee9e'
files = {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in (terms, crosswalk, packet)}
assert files[str(terms)] == expected, 'Terms differ from the pending approval version'
assert isinstance(json.loads(packet.read_text()).get('replies'), dict), 'Reply packet schema mismatch'
json.loads(crosswalk.read_text())
receipt = {'terms_sha256': expected, 'artifact_sha256': files, 'effect': 'Binds the exact proposal, acceptance crosswalk and existing reply packet for operator handoff. No approval or customer event was checked by this execution.', 'routing': {'diagnostic': 'Use the applicable verified live scope and the diagnostic branch for an eligible inquiry in the authorized private cycle.', 'commission': 'Use the nonbinding branch until operator approval of these exact terms is evidenced. Buyer confirmation and administrative acceptance are separate.', 'settlement': 'Record deposit attestation and Treasury posting separately.'}}
output = root / 'operator-handoff-binding.json'
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
assert json.loads(output.read_text()) == receipt
print(output)
